notes: ImdWindowShopper (IWS) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no transfer fees, administrative powers or external minting functions. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the token's total supply.
